checks.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- RTK.md ---' && sed -n '1,260p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex/RTK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- law.md ---' && sed -n '1,260p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex/law.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- required project docs ---' && for f in README.md 00_START_HERE.md 02_Source_Audit.md 09_Delivery_and_Gates.md 11_Developer_Start.md 13_Package_Review.md; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --short && rtk find tools tests -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk --version && rtk git status --short && rtk rg --files tools tests | sort && rtk sed -n '1,360p' tests/test_package.py && rtk sed -n '1,360p' tools/check_package.py"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '1,220p' .gitignore && rtk sed -n '1,220p' manifest.json && rtk sed -n '1,220p' CONTRIBUTING.md && rtk sed -n '1,220p' evidence/README.md && rtk rg -n \"artifacts|evidence/review|ignored|manifest\" .github tools tests README.md 13_Package_Review.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk python3 -c 'from tests.test_source_preflight import SourcePreflightTests; case=SourcePreflightTests(\"test_safe_archive_is_staged_and_baseline_is_discovered\"); case.setUp(); actual=case.make_archive([(f\"{case.SOURCE_ROOT}/\", \"\"), (f\"{case.SOURCE_ROOT}/src/module.py\", \"print(\\\\\"fixture\\\\\")\\\\n\"), (f\"{case.SOURCE_ROOT}/tests/test_module.py\", \"def test_fixture():\\\\n    assert True\\\\n\"), (f\"{case.SOURCE_ROOT}/requirements.txt\", \"fixture-dependency==1\\\\n\")]); print(case.run_preflight(expected_hash=actual)); case.doCleanups()'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk python3 -c 'from tests.test_source_preflight import SourcePreflightTests; case=SourcePreflightTests(\"test_safe_archive_is_staged_and_baseline_is_discovered\"); case.setUp(); actual=case.make_archive([(f\"{SOURCE_ROOT}/\", \"\") for SOURCE_ROOT in [\"fixture_source_release\"]]); print(case.run_preflight(expected_hash=actual)); case.doCleanups()'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git diff -- tools/source_preflight.py tests/test_source_preflight.py README.md 11_Developer_Start.md && rtk git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk mkdir -p artifacts/w0 && set +e
rtk python3 tools/source_preflight.py --output artifacts/source-preflight.json > artifacts/w0/source-preflight-cli.log 2>&1
cli_status=$?
rtk python3 -m unittest tests.test_source_preflight -v > artifacts/w0/source-preflight-tests.log 2>&1
preflight_tests_status=$?
rtk python3 tools/check_package.py > artifacts/w0/package-check.log 2>&1
package_status=$?
rtk python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v > artifacts/w0/repository-tests.log 2>&1
repository_tests_status=$?
rtk git diff --check > artifacts/w0/diff-check.log 2>&1
diff_status=$?
print "cli_status=$cli_status" >> artifacts/w0/source-preflight-cli.log
print "preflight_tests_status=$preflight_tests_status" >> artifacts/w0/source-preflight-tests.log
print "package_status=$package_status" >> artifacts/w0/package-check.log
print "repository_tests_status=$repository_tests_status" >> artifacts/w0/repository-tests.log
print "diff_status=$diff_status" >> artifacts/w0/diff-check.log
print "cli_status=$cli_status preflight_tests_status=$preflight_tests_status package_status=$package_status repository_tests_status=$repository_tests_status diff_status=$diff_status"'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short && rtk git diff --stat && rtk git diff -- manifest.json && rtk sed -n '1,120p' artifacts/source-preflight.json && rtk sed -n '1,80p' artifacts/w0/source-preflight-cli.log && rtk sed -n '1,80p' artifacts/w0/source-preflight-tests.log && rtk find artifacts -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort"
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --short && rtk git status --short -- evidence evidence/import && rtk git diff --check && rtk python3 tools/check_package.py'
